import tslearn.metrics
import numpy as np

# Compute cross-similarity matrix between X and X2
sim_matrix = tslearn.metrics.cdist_gak(X, X2, sigma=2.0)
assert sim_matrix.shape == (8, 4), f"Expected cross-similarity shape (8, 4), got {sim_matrix.shape}"

# Compute self-similarity matrix for X
self_sim = tslearn.metrics.cdist_gak(X, sigma=2.0)
assert self_sim.shape == (8, 8), f"Expected self-similarity shape (8, 8), got {self_sim.shape}"

# GAK similarity is normalized such that self-similarity of identical series is 1.0
np.testing.assert_allclose(np.diag(self_sim), 1.0, atol=1e-5)

print(f"__CHECK__ cdist_gak {sim_matrix.shape} {self_sim.shape}")
